items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Harrison Bonds told me about him.

ctx.x: Sam Dutry Sr., he played with me quite a bit. You know, we was practically in the same age group. And we were pretty good friends. And he played with me quite a bit. He never was a member of the band. He played with us quite a bit.
I think Harrison Bonds told me about him.
